test_llm_generate_text: test the llm.generate_text function with a custom executable that appends a sampling key to the prompt
test_llm_select: test the llm.select function with score_factory to pick the highest-scoring target from a list of options
test_llm_rank: test the llm.rank function to rank multiple target options by score with optional token healing
test_llm_chat: test the llm.chat function with different formatters to format message sequences into prompts
test_llm_instruct: test the llm.instruct function with assistant prefix and formatter to generate formatted instruction prompts
